# Records Archive Application - Project Complete

This React TypeScript application has been scaffolded and customized with:

- Authentication system with Microsoft Authentication model
- Bearer Token authorization for all API calls
- Microsoft SQL Server backend integration via Web API
- Protected routes with authentication guards
- Modern, responsive UI with gradient backgrounds
- Comprehensive logging for debugging
- Test coverage for components and services

## Project Structure
- `src/components/` - React components including ProtectedRoute
- `src/contexts/` - Authentication context and providers
- `src/pages/` - Login and Dashboard pages
- `src/services/` - API services with Bearer Token auth
- `src/types/` - TypeScript type definitions
- `src/utils/` - Utility functions including logger

## Available Scripts
- `npm start` - Run development server
- `npm test` - Run test suite
- `npm run build` - Create production build

## Configuration
Set `REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL` in `.env.local` to configure the backend API endpoint.

All checklist items completed successfully.
